name: Clerk — Open Graph social card by clerk.com
description: A 1200×630 social card built on a near-black canvas with a radial blue glow rising from the right. Three layers carry the composition: a small white wordmark at top-left, a giant glossy 3D rendition of the C-shaped logo mark occupying the right half with a blue orb at its core, and a bold two-line headline anchored bottom-left where 'comprehensive' and 'Platform' shift to pale sky blue. Faint circuit-trace line art in the upper right adds texture without competing at thumbnail size. The diagonal reading path (wordmark → headline → artwork) and the stark scale contrast between the ~64px headline and the ~32px wordmark make it instantly legible in a 40px-tall link preview.
